contentList.content: An enemy that ends its turn in a lightly or heavily obscured area takes a Lesser Brand of Darkness.

An enemy takes a Brand of Darkness whenever it ends its turn in a lightly or heavily obscured area, or when you damage it with an attack in such an area.

Allies in an obscured area gain Devil's Sight.

An enemy takes a Deep Brand of Darkness whenever it ends its turn in a lightly or heavily obscured area, or when you damage it there with an attack or a spell.

Allies in an obscured area gain Devil's Sight.

An enemy takes a Greater Brand of Darkness whenever it ends its turn in a lightly or heavily obscured area, when you damage it there with an attack or a spell, and when your[1] damage reaches it there.

Allies in an obscured area gain Devil's Sight.

You ignore immunity to[1].
You see through magical darkness and are not blinded by it.
Killing a creature inside a Darkness Cloud grants you Devil's Sight for [1] turns, letting you see through magical darkness.
